newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MONTGOMERY ON ASCEND.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MONTGOMERY ON ASCEND.

text.p: Montgomery Securities issued internal comments to its sales force saying that Ascend Communications Inc's earnings for the first month of the third quarter appear to be lower than expected, a Montgomery source said.
-- Source said that an 8K filing by Ascend listed the company's sales and net income for the month of July, which Montgomery calculated to equal about $0.02 a share.
-- Noted the earnings are less than a third of Montgomery's estimate for Ascend's third quarter of $0.36 a share. First Call consenses estimate is also $0.36 a share.
-- Said Montgomery had made no immediate changes to its rating or earnings per share estimates on Ascend.
